note: Target-agnostic. Backend bindings: GitHub Copilot chat completions (ai.py), SerpAPI, GitHub REST API, local corpus files in tools/data/, and the tested poc_store shell script. Per-target intelligence is supplied at runtime by dropping files into tools/data/target/ (e.g. an exported GraphQL schema, site pages, API docs).

tools.name: payload_library.search
tools.description: Keyword-scored search over the local payload corpus (reports.md) of real, previously-successful vulnerability reports. Query by weakness type (XSS, SQLi, SSRF, CSRF, IDOR, SSTI, RCE, CRLF, CORS, DoS) or by payload behavior.

tools.name: payload_library.grep
tools.description: Exact case-insensitive substring match inside the payload corpus with surrounding context.

tools.name: payload_library.read
tools.description: Read corpus content at a position. uri format: local://<filename>?at=POSITION

tools.name: target_intel.search
tools.description: Keyword-scored search over per-target intelligence files the operator places in tools/data/target/ (exported GraphQL schemas, API docs, site pages, config exports). This is how a target's attack surface is mapped before testing.

tools.name: repo_intel.get_file
tools.description: Retrieve file contents from the target GitHub repository. Priority: README, .gitignore, dependency manifests, Dockerfile, .env.example, entry points, routes, auth middleware, validation code.

tools.name: repo_intel.search_code
tools.description: Search code for vulnerability patterns: eval(, exec(, system(, spawn, SQL statements, fs operations, deserialization, template engines, hardcoded secrets.

tools.name: repo_intel.list_commits
tools.description: List recent repository commits to understand activity and security-relevant changes.

tools.name: research.web_search
tools.description: SerpAPI Google search for CVEs, public bug bounty reports, and exploit PoCs. Operators supported: site:, intitle:, inurl:, filetype:, quoted phrases, OR. start_date/end_date appended as after:/before:.

tools.name: research.open_url
tools.description: Retrieve full content of a URL from a research result, with HTML tags stripped for context efficiency.

tools.name: research.news_search
tools.description: SerpAPI Google News search for recent security advisories and disclosures with explicit date ranges.

tools.name: http.request
tools.description: Execute a PoC HTTP request against an in-scope target with full request/response capture: status, headers, body, timing, and a request echo for the POC record. Redirects are not followed.

tools.name: poc_store.save
tools.description: Persist a verified, successful PoC. Validates mandatory sections and confirmed status; rejects incomplete, unconfirmed, or duplicate records.

tools.name: poc_store.discard
tools.description: Discard a failed attempt. Only a one-line timestamped reason is logged to pocs/_failures.log.

tools.name: poc_store.list
tools.description: List stored POCs with type and severity for deduplication and chaining analysis.
